fix.title: Protect tonight's sleep
fix.body: Short sleep pushes more of the loss onto lean mass instead of fat (Nedeltcheva 2010), so a good night is worth more than a smaller plate right now. Guard lights-out before you touch the deficit.
fix.whyNot: On short sleep a deeper cut spends muscle; a full night keeps the loss coming off fat. Sleep is the lever tonight, not food.
